component.name: KonoKashi
component.summary: Synchronized multilingual lyrics for Linux players

description.p: KonoKashi follows MPRIS playback in a native Linux desktop window and displays synchronized lyrics from local files, an offline cache, or LRCLIB.

Original-script lyrics remain authoritative. Aligned romanization or transliteration can appear beneath the original, with translation kept as a separate optional layer. Settings and user-approved corrections are stored locally.
Internal development milestone; no public release was created.
